limits: A rating is ★ coaching over ◆ inputs; the score never gates. The floor (bracket_report.json) is the only bracket gate.
calibrate.py refuses a verdict below 10 decks with 20 games each; no figure here is checked against outcomes yet (`rating --calibrate` reports the refusal with today's n).
Goldfish kill is one column, never the rule: the benchmark is an unopposed ceiling with no blockers and no removal, and a combo or control deck reads slow for not attacking.
Forge is not a power read until the harness work is done (the pilot's rule, 2026-10-18): its component ships at weight 0.00 and is shown only for a run on the current list.
DeckCheck's Threat Index is shown in `context` and never scored.
Diagnostic engine figures are read against each deck's own declaration and are never ranked across decks; they are evidence for the argument, not a component.
rank over n=3 decks; no significance claim

judgment.argument: Withheld: no surveyed games and no Forge run on the current list, so nothing shows how this rebuilt list plays at a table. No game is logged on it. Every logged game was on an older list: the first debrief I cite and the last both carry a different list hash from the rated one, and the last has no result. They show what the earlier builds suffered, a creature-heavy board eating wipes and running out of cards late, and Edgar the only Vampire cast. They do not describe this list, and the rebuild was made in answer to them, so I give them no weight against it. The clock sits in speed, the winless record in table_record, and ramp and card advantage under their bands in construction; I do not deduct for any of them a second time. On capacity, resilience carries 18 answer cards and protection reads over its band, so the old complaint of thin protection is not borne out on this list by the audit. The engine write-up predates the rebuild, so its two no-combat kill routes are the declared plan, not credit. Nothing recorded on the current list argues the measured components undersell or oversell it, so I land where they say it.
